name: p99_d1_explicit_hand_workspace_depth_geometry
hypothesis: D0 retained only globally pooled Depth semantics. Explicit per-frame hand/body/workspace position and local depth-surface relations may turn Depth candidate coverage into subject-disjoint hard rescues without changing the visual backbone, fusion rule, Student loss, or training budget.

descriptor.depth_rank: OpenCV HSV hue / 120 on saturated nonblack Depth_Color pixels; black pixels are invalid
descriptor.geometry: normalized ROI centers/scales/quality plus shoulder-elbow-wrist coordinates and hand/body/workspace relations

selection: highest H1 correct, then balanced accuracy, Top-5, lower log loss, lexical recipe name
h2_policy: H2 descriptor extraction and confirmation require the frozen H1 summary; H3 has no code path
stop_rule: If depth_geometry produces no stable hard complementarity beyond geometry_only and cannot beat D0 rescue/harm quality, close this Depth representation route rather than tuning alpha, thresholds, seed, or Student hyperparameters.
